Package edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.gen

Class MonsterPopulator

java.lang.Object
edu.towson.cosc442.halls7800.gen.MonsterPopulator
public class MonsterPopulator extends Object
Places the starting monsters on a generated floor.

Monsters appear in ordinary and exit rooms, never in the entrance room, vaults or hidden rooms, and never within SAFE_RADIUS tiles of the arrival point. Pack monsters bring up to PACK_EXTRA companions.
